messages:
Samir: Quick sync on HeliosGrid EAP — NDA signed yesterday. Need final bench plan, telemetry hooks, and cloud marketplace packaging checklist by EOD Fri. Who owns the packaging work?
Anya: @Samir I can own marketplace packaging + listing draft. Will need the SKU mapping from HeliosGrid. Can PM ask for it? :point_right:
Mike: I'll take benchmarks and perf matrix. Planning two runs: 1) latency/throughput sweep; 2) long-context regen (8k). Draft bench config: ```yaml
model: redwood/open-8b
sequence_lengths: [1024, 8192]
batch_sizes: [1, 8, 16]
metrics: [p50, p95, throughput, cost_per_token]
warmup_steps: 50
```
Leo: @Mike add KV-cache warmup and quantization profiles (int8, fp16) to the matrix. Also capture GPU topology (NUMA) in the run metadata. :mag:
Samir: Also need legal-approved NDA blurbs for joint announcement. @partners-bot can you drop the NDA clause snippet we agreed previously?
partners-bot: Snippet: "Partner and Redwood will mutually approve press materials at least 7 days prior to publication; performance claims must be validated by a joint benchmark report and tagged with test vectors and config." See internal doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/press-templates/partner-agreements
Anya: For marketplace packaging: container tag format should be `redwood/heliosgrid:hhg-v1.0`, include `/licenses/HELIOS_LICENSE.txt` in the image, and add listing metadata: short_description, region_availability, supported_instance_types. I'll open a PR for the listing template.
Mike: One risk to call out: HeliosGrid depends on vendor RDMA drivers for peak throughput. If they can't deliver drivers by handoff, fallback is soft-net QEMU path (lower perf). We should document fallback thresholds in the runbook. :warning:
Samir: Good point. Can we meet Wed 10am PT to align runbook + announcement timeline? I'll send a calendar invite and include HeliosGrid PM for SKU + driver ETA.
Anya: Added action items: 1) PR for marketplace listing (Anya) 2) Bench runs + perf matrix (Mike) 3) Runbook section for driver fallback + metrics (Leo) 4) NDA/press snippet confirm (Samir/legal).
Mike: Will post initial bench results as a short thread in #eng-ml once first run completes.
Samir: Thanks all — aim to lock this by Friday so we can schedule the joint announcement next week. :rocket:
